reason: I run a branch with a lot of regulars over 45 and a chain's standards to answer to. I will not put my tables and my orders on a system from a company that has no restaurant using it yet, however cheap it looks.
objection: Who are you? A new company with no restaurants using it yet, so if it breaks on a Friday night I am the guinea pig and nobody has told me who else has survived it.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three sit-down restaurants like mine running it live for a few months, with owners I can phone and ask about breakdowns and staff pushback.
